bin/jg-watch.sh: A task record names this pane, so the watcher still reads the marker.
No task record names this pane, so only a remover can delete the marker.

column7: teardown deletes the task record that named the pane
the backend reports the pane absent

markers: d=${JG_STATE_OVERRIDE:-${JG_HOME:-.}/state}; [ -e "$d/$1" ] || { echo removed; exit; }; awk -F= -v k="${1##*-}" '$1=="window"||$1=="terminal"{v=$2; gsub(/[:\/.]/,"_",v); if(v==k)f=1} END{print f?"owned":"orphan"}' "$d"/*.meta 2>/dev/null || echo orphan

machine: # marker lines (read by tests/jg-machine-markers.test.sh, not by the engine): kind, writer file, key, remover file:function or - for none
